items.headline: Albemarle Appoints Former Vale CEO Eduardo Bartolomeo as Outside Director
items.snippet: Albemarle's appointment of Eduardo Bartolomeo, the former CEO of Vale, as an outside director is a positive signal for Albemarle's strategy to expand lithium production and optimize its supply chain.

items.headline: Albemarle Stock Loses 25% in a Month: What Should Investors Do Now?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation's ALB shares have tumbled 25.5% in the past month, underperforming the Zacks Chemical - Diversified industry and the S&P 500's declines of 6.7% and 0.1%, respectively. Falling lithium market prices are weighing on the ALB stock lately.

items.headline: The U.S. Is Increasing Efforts to Rebuild Its Rare Earth Supply Chain
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation just posted a sharp turnaround. First-quarter 2026 adjusted EBITDA jumped 148% year over year to $664 million as lithium prices rebounded from 2025 lows. The company used the recovery to cut debt too, retiring $1.3 billion of obligations during the quarter.
